speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me more about the fever and seizure, specifically how long they lasted and if you've taken any new medications recently? I also need to know if the rash appeared before or after the fever started.

speaker: Patient
text: 9-month-old infant. The patient is brought in due to a generalized nonpruritic rash for 2 days. The rash started on the trunk and spread to the extremities. Five days ago, the patient had a fever of 40.5°C (104.9°F) and experienced a 1-minute generalized tonic-clonic seizure. The infant was born at term, has no history of serious illness, and her immunizations are up to date. The current medication includes acetaminophen.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the fever resolve completely before the rash appeared? Also, has the infant returned to their normal playful and interactive behavior since the fever subsided?
